mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 PM, here is today's balanced dish. It is 83 degrees with clear skies over Reddan Soccer Park and an air quality index of 57. The overnight low will reach 63 degrees with no rain expected.

The City of Verona has launched a rain barrel rebate program where residents can receive a credit on their utility bill for installing qualifying rain barrels. Additionally, the final design for the new city skatepark will be presented at a virtual meeting on August 6 from 6:00 to 7:30 PM.

There is plenty to do today including the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market and Trivia Night at The Bogey Factory. Looking ahead, you can enjoy Concerts in the Park tomorrow evening at Century School Park.
During the past week, officers were kept busy, including an incident on Saturday where a driver was arrested for an O W I after being clocked at 97 miles per hour on US Highways 18 and 151.

Today's flavor at Culver's is the delicious Caramel Peanut Buttercup. If you are looking for a cool treat, you can also visit the Kona Ice truck at Fireman's Park until 4:30 PM or the Verona Farmers Market until 6:30 PM today.
